kpi_procedures.description: Average Basket Value = TotalSalesValue / NetBills. NetBills = COUNT(DISTINCT SALES invoices) - COUNT(DISTINCT non-SALES invoices). TotalSalesValue = SUM(NETAMT) for SALES invoices only. The procedure returns only the requested dimension columns plus the ABV value — intermediate columns (NetBills, TotalSalesValue) are not in the output.
output_columns: <date period column when time_grain is set — e.g. Week, Month>
